purpose: Non-admission discovery registry of official insurance legal-entity identifiers and national/regional market benchmark data needed to calibrate synthetic insurer and reinsurer CAT portfolios.

entries.name: EIOPA Register of Insurance Undertakings
entries.provider: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA)
entries.spatial_scope: EU/EEA insurance undertakings and notified cross-border operations; national registers have authoritative precedence
entries.temporal_scope: EIOPA states updates weekly on Fridays; extract must pin capture timestamp and actual registration dates
entries.resolution_or_granularity: public CSV/Excel table of insurer name, NCA, home country, identifiers, LEI if supplied, cross-border country, authorisation, start/end dates and status
entries.note: This is a register of authorised legal entities and cross-border operations, not property risk locations or market shares; subsidiaries and cross-border rows must not be counted as independent groups. The EIOPA page says national NCA records prevail on discrepancies; preserve identification-code namespace, LEI missingness, home versus host country, registration validity and extraction date. Public CSV access does not itself clear automated harvesting or redistribution.

entries.name: GLEIF Global LEI Index Level 1 and Level 2 corporate relationships
entries.spatial_scope: global cross-sector LEI holders, not limited to insurers
entries.temporal_scope: continuously updated; Golden Copy and delta files published up to three times daily
entries.resolution_or_granularity: LEI Level 1 identity records and Level 2 direct/ultimate accounting-consolidating parent relationships with reporting exceptions; API, full-file and delta access
entries.note: LEI identifies legal entities, not insured assets. The Level 2 parent link is accounting-consolidation based and can be absent or exception-reported; do not infer missing links or beneficial ownership. Preserve LEI, record status, effective dates, relationship type, exception, source vintage, mapping confidence and original identifiers. Review official data licensing and file/API terms before ingestion.

entries.name: EIOPA Solvency II aggregated insurance statistics to 2026 Q2
entries.provider: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA)
entries.spatial_scope: European Economic Area with country-level aggregates for solo/group insurance undertakings
entries.temporal_scope: quarterly solo 2016 Q3 through 2026 Q2 and annual through 2025; group series follow their own publication schedule
entries.resolution_or_granularity: CSV/XLSX aggregates for premiums, claims and expenses (S.05.01), own funds/SCR (S.23.01), balance sheet (S.02.01), investment asset exposures (S.06.02); solo/group, quarter/year, country, measure
entries.note: Latest page update observed 2026-10-12; quarterly values can be provisional and revised. These are aggregated reporting data, NOT individual insurer premium, geographic CAT exposure, claim triangles, or catastrophe insured loss. Never sum solo and group observations or mix provisional and final series; retain currency, measure code, reporting basis, frequency, country, year, publication vintage and Solvency II QRT definitions.

entries.name: EIOPA Solvency II cross-border insurance premiums 2023-2025
entries.provider: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA)
entries.spatial_scope: EEA with cross-border reporting jurisdiction and country breakdown; contract-signing vs risk-location semantics depend on business class
entries.temporal_scope: annual series 2023 through 2025; earlier series provided separately
entries.resolution_or_granularity: XLSX aggregated annual Solvency II solo cross-border premiums by country with publication metadata
entries.note: Do not equate insurance premium booking jurisdiction, insurer domicile and physical location of the CAT risk. Preserve country role, branch/FOS reporting basis, business class, period, value, currency and coverage, and avoid double counting underlying domestic/group totals. Public annual series is not per-risk geocoded insurance exposure.

entries.name: OECD Insurance business written by class of insurance (DSD_INS@DF_CLASSES)
entries.provider: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
entries.spatial_scope: OECD and participating non-OECD reporting jurisdictions; country coverage varies by series
entries.temporal_scope: annual historical country series, latest available year varies; OECD Data Explorer page updated 2025-12-08 at source review
entries.resolution_or_granularity: OECD SDMX 1.0 dataflow DSD_INS@DF_CLASSES: insurance class, gross written premium metrics, country, accounting basis, currency, year
entries.note: Exact SDMX flow: OECD.DAF.CM,DSD_INS@DF_CLASSES,1.0; query structure metadata before selecting dimensions, then pin request, response format, release and date. Class-of-business premiums are not individual insurer exposure and cannot be disaggregated into peril- or building-specific insured values without explicit modelling assumptions. Preserve missing observations and reporting changes.

entries.name: OECD Premiums claims and expenses (DSD_INS@DF_UNDERWRITING)
entries.provider: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
entries.spatial_scope: OECD and reporting non-OECD jurisdictions with different historical coverage
entries.temporal_scope: annual historical series; latest year country/measure specific and dataflow page updated 2025-12-08 at source review
entries.resolution_or_granularity: OECD SDMX dataflow DSD_INS@DF_UNDERWRITING covering direct and reinsurance-accepted premiums, ceded premiums, net premiums, gross claims, costs, ownership and location dimensions
entries.note: Exact SDMX flow OECD.DAF.CM,DSD_INS@DF_UNDERWRITING,1.0. Gross premiums, ceded premiums, accepted reinsurance and paid claims are distinct accounting measures; paid claims are NOT event-level CAT incurred insured losses and do not reveal contract attachment points. Pin denominator, reporting scope, units and revision dates before country comparisons. Check OECD service licence/API policy before storing source bytes.

entries.name: IAIS Global Insurance Market Report 2025 (public aggregate)
entries.spatial_scope: globally pooled supervisory monitoring and selected markets; 58 jurisdictions participated in at least one sector-wide 2025 component
entries.temporal_scope: December 2025 report with sector and reinsurance metrics largely through year-end 2024
entries.resolution_or_granularity: public PDF charts and aggregated tables covering reinsurance premiums, capital, retention, retrocession and industry-wide indicators; individual insurer submissions are confidential
entries.note: IAIS 2025 public report uses confidential Individual Insurer Monitoring and Sector-Wide Monitoring submissions. Only publicly released aggregates may be researched after copyright review; do not infer the 57 insurer-level observations from report totals or fabricate group-specific treaty/retro placements. Distinguish 2024 observation period from 2025 publication and do not call the 2026 report released before its official publication.
